title: DEC-235: Slice 12 idempotency binding follows BE00 actor scope (2026-10-29)
text:
- **Problem**: BE03c Shared Contract Inheritance (line 150) and P2-S12-AC-056 said a changed actor under the same Idempotency-Key returns 409, but BE00 makes `(actor_id, operation, key_hash)` the unique binding, so a different actor is a distinct binding. Refutation round 2 (lane a, AC-056 c9) found the only cited 409 was the stale entry version, not the actor.
- **Options considered**: (A) align BE03c and AC-056 with BE00 as BE03a did for AC300 on 2026-10-02: a different actor is a distinct binding; the same actor with a changed server-resolved acting party, body, path or version is 409; (B) widen the reservation to collide across actors, contradicting BE00 and every Slice 09-11 CMS route; (C) leave the clause uncited as a spec/code divergence.
- **Decision**: A (root, owner may override; precedent AC300). `cms_reserve` already folds the server-resolved acting party into the request hash (template_authority.sql: 'CMS same key cannot replay across server-resolved acting parties'), so the 409 axis for the same person is the acting party. AC-056's text becomes 'answers a changed acting party, body, path or version under the same key with 409'; the acting-party clause needs a CMS-03C-04 pgTAP case (the template case is an adjacent route).
- **Downstream**: BE03c line 150 + changelog; phase-2.md and the Slice 12 tracker AC-056 text; ledger 001-071 AC-056 clauses; a gap test for CMS-03C-04 replay under another acting party.
- **Reversibility**: High

title: PAT-036: A real-route harness must compose every production boundary, and tests/e2e type assertions are blind (2026-10-29)
text:
- **Type**: anti-pattern
- **Confidence**: 0.5 (first occurrence)
- **Context**: Real-route Playwright specs drive the web against a harness API Worker (`tests/e2e/support/content-schema-registry-api.ts`) that composes production CMS dependencies selectively.
- **Pattern**: Avoid composing the harness Worker by hand-picking boundaries: an omitted boundary leaves its routes unregistered, the Worker answers 404 and the web relay turns it into a 502 that looks like a product failure ([T7]: `cmsTaxonomy`, CMS-03C-03, plus four other boundaries were missing). Pin harness/production parity with a runtime Vitest (`tests/e2e/support/s12-real-governed.test.ts`), not a type assertion: `tests/e2e/**` belongs to no tsc project, so a compile-time check there never fails (verified by mutation). Diagnose a real-route 502 with a well-formed body and no server log line by checking route registration first.
- **Source**: Slice 12 [T7] failure diagnosis and fix, 2026-10-29.

title: DEC-236: A changed acting party never replays; an out-of-scope target answers its concealed 404 before the reservation (2026-10-29)
text:
- **Problem**: DEC-235 made AC-056 say a changed server-resolved acting party under the same key is 409. Lane gaps-db3 showed CMS-03C-04 checks the entry's ownership and visibility before it reserves the key (20260927580000:94-106), so a changed party meets the concealed 404 and the 409 is unreachable there; the party-bound fingerprint is real at the reservation primitive and the 409 is reachable on CMS-03B-10 (no addressed target).
- **Options considered**: (A) keep the concealment-first order and word the rule as 'never replays; 409 where no addressed target is out of scope, else the target's concealed 404'; (B) reserve before the visibility check so the 409 is reachable everywhere — a caller could then tell an existing out-of-scope entry from an absent one (existence probe); (C) leave the clause uncited as a BOUNDARY.
- **Decision**: A (root, owner may override). Concealment before reservation is the BE00 order and the security-correct one. BE03c line 150 + changelog amended; AC-056 text: 'answers a changed body, path or version under the same key with 409, and never replays to a changed acting party (an entry outside its scope is the concealed 404, answered before the key is reserved).' Citations wait for refutation 3 of the gaps-db3 proposals.
- **Downstream**: phase-2.md, Slice 12 tracker, ledger 001-071 AC-056 (two clauses); AC-292 (CMS-03B-10) shows the 409 form.
- **Reversibility**: High

title: DEC-237: Taxonomy activation checks the declared-domain provider before the frozen comparison (2026-10-29)
text:
- **Problem**: BE03c 1490 orders the dependency recheck (step 4) before the taxonomy provider preflight (step 5); the shared activation verdict (20261014070200:5-7, 58-64) checks the provider first. Because the canonical registry is versioned, a provider that became unbuilt after approval always has a new row, so the spec's order would turn it into a dependency_changed invalidation and make AC-210/AC-223's 422 canonical_source_unavailable at activation unreachable.
- **Options considered**: (A) state the implemented order in step (5): unbuilt provider → 422, approval kept (scheduled path blocks the same way); a provider replaced by another BUILT provider → step-4 invalidation; (B) follow step numbering, invalidating the approval on any provider change — contradicts the ratified AC-210/AC-223 and BE03c 416/1478; (C) ask the owner.
- **Decision**: A (root, owner may override). The ratified criteria fix the outcome; only the step text was inconsistent. BE03c step (5) amended + changelog row. A provider outage refuses activation and keeps the approval, consistent with the fire-time blocked outcome.
- **Downstream**: AC-210, AC-223 citations (gaps_db4_taxonomy_activation.sql) stand on the implemented order.
- **Reversibility**: High

title: DEC-238: Canonical registry provider key and version are each non-null exactly when built (2026-10-29)
text:
- **Problem**: BE03c 1624's CHECK ((provider_state='built') = (key IS NOT NULL AND version IS NOT NULL)) admits an unbuilt row holding exactly one of provider_key / provider_version; the ratified AC-256 says each is non-null exactly when built. Lane gaps-db4 wrote a fix-forward pair CHECK; refute3 called it a spec ambiguity and required the spec first.
- **Options considered**: (A) amend BE03c 1624 to the criterion's reading and promote the pair CHECK; (B) keep the DDL and drop the two pair probes, leaving AC-256's 'exactly when' unproven.
- **Decision**: A (root, owner may override): the ratified criterion is the stricter, explicit text; the CHECK is satisfied by every seeded row.
- **Downstream**: BE03c 1624 + changelog; WIP 20261029110000 promoted after refute3's conditions; AC-256 citations.
- **Reversibility**: High

title: DEC-239: CMS-03C-08 answers 201 without a Location header (2026-10-29)
text:
- **Problem**: refute4 found the CMS-03C-08 Worker route sets `Location: /api/v1/cms/governed-reviews/{reviewId}/assignments/{assignmentId}` on a 201 (governed-review-command-routes.ts:283). P2-S12-AC-272 says every assignment identifier never enters a URL; BE03c row 176 defines the response as 201/200 GovernedReviewAssignmentResource with no Location.
- **Options considered**: (A) drop the header — the id stays in the strict resource body the owner receives; (B) keep it and read 'URL' as navigable browser URLs only; (C) ask the owner.
- **Decision**: A (root, owner may override): it satisfies AC-272 under either reading, matches BE03c row 176 exactly, and no web code reads the header.
- **Downstream**: Worker route + its contract test (RED first); AC-272 citation of the no-Location test.
- **Reversibility**: High

title: DEC-240: Restore records only the vocabularies of carried assignments (2026-10-29)
text:
- **Problem**: migration 20261024100700 keeps a source-recorded taxonomy version whose vocabulary has no carried assignment and marks it `BOUNDARY: 03c states the rule for assignments only`; the closeout test (open BOUNDARY set closed) fails on it. BE03c 1593 says the new revision's taxonomy_version_ids are the vocabularies' current active ids.
- **Options considered**: (A) not carried — one current active id per vocabulary with a carried assignment, as every revision writer records (AC-246); (B) keep the recorded id (as implemented) — a stale recorded version can block publication of a restored revision with no terms (taxonomy_version_not_active); (C) bump it to the vocabulary's current active id — records a version that governs nothing.
- **Decision**: A (root, owner may override): consistent with the writers and with the spec's 'current active' wording; no taxonomy data is lost (no assignment, empty value).
- **Downstream**: BE03c 1593 + changelog; fix-forward migration (lane gaps-db5) + RED test; closeout test treats the 100700 marker as superseded by the fix-forward migration.
- **Reversibility**: Medium

title: DEC-241: FE03 state-table readings for the Slice 12 islands (refute5 section 7) (2026-10-29)
text:
- **Problem**: refute5 asked root for readings before AC-271/AC-042 and the page-level criteria can be cited or fixed.
- **Options considered**: per item, the stricter spec reading vs the implemented behaviour.
- **Decision** (root, owner may override): (1) G-A1: a degraded governed detail does not keep the stale review on screen — 're-required' means re-read before shown; a web7 defect. (2) Cancel/Back while a command is in flight stay locked in BOTH the term action and activation (activation's FE03 1118/1216 reading; FE03 1048's commit-only rule governs inputs, not navigation away from an unknown outcome). (3) A state an island cannot enter (connected taxonomy selector idle, governed queue loading) is N/A, named in the limitation, not a defect. (4) 409 refetch: web7 reports what FE03 requires for reviewer_not_eligible before any change. (5) AC-042 c5 'provenance/next action': web7 item (render the parent version provenance the resource carries). (6) A mount-only page test does NOT close 'consumed by … at /app/…' (DEC-226 needs page-level behaviour): AC-058/105/111/129 c0 stay open until a test performs the operation from the page. The 20 AC-271 rows refute5 found pinning defects stay uncited and are rewritten in the web7 commit that fixes them.
- **Downstream**: apply4 (AC-271 8-part split, parts 0 and 3 cited; AC-058/105/111/129 not verified from mount tests); web7 brief.
- **Reversibility**: High

title: DEC-242: FE03 state-table readings from lane web7 (2026-10-29)
text:
- **Problem**: lane web7 fixed most AC-271 cells and asked for readings on the rest.
- **Options considered**: per item, change the product, or read the cell against the rest of FE03.
- **Decision** (root, owner may override): (1) G1: 'keeps the last verified queue with lastVerifiedAt' applies where an island re-reads in place; the governed queue is a no-store server-rendered page with no client re-read and FE03 1018/1630 forbid browser storage, so its degraded state is the closed notice with Retry (FE03 cell amended accordingly). (2) Locale FALLBACK_CHAIN_MISMATCH is reconciled by the 409 body itself (no extra refetch). (3) 409 auto-refetch and unknown-outcome refetch-before-retry stay DEFECTS against FE03 (the explicit 'Check latest version' press is not 'refetched automatically') — fixed per island group in a later wave. (4) reviewer_not_eligible: FE03 884's fixed copy plus a refetch of the review — the form must refetch (small defect, same wave).
- **Downstream**: FE03 state table; AC-271 limitation; the 409/unknown-outcome wave.
- **Reversibility**: High

title: DEC-243: The designer context lists every registered, supported block (blocks have no tenant owner) (2026-10-29)
text:
- **Problem**: lane block_owner proved RED that `cms_template_context` (20261013100500:99-100) lists blocks `owner_id = acting_party_id`, while a CMS-03A-05 block is owned by its signed release principal (cms_release_actor), so no organization designer ever sees a released block in the template or pattern chooser; the CMS-03C-01/-12 validators accept any registered block. BE03c 206 said 'owned'.
- **Options considered**: (A) list every registered, supported block (128 cap); (B) bind release principals to an organization and owner-scope every block reader (tenancy redesign, reverses the Slice 09 ruling); (C) A with an extra dead org-owned arm.
- **Decision**: A (root, owner may override; root first put A/B/C to the owner, then the lane found the ratified precedent): Slice 09 already ruled blocks are platform registry records, never tenant data (migration 20261002209000 removed the owner predicate from CMS-03A-06/-07; oracle P2-S09-AC-145), and no spec binds a release principal to an organization. BE03c 206 'owned' was stale; amended with FE03 1129.
- **Downstream**: forward migration of cms_template_context; RED suite phase_02_slice_12_block_owner_red.sql green; corrections in gaps_db1_template.sql foreign-block assertions and the S12 ledger text that described owner scoping; pw7 AC-105 page tests.
- **Reversibility**: High
